blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Manifold-constrained Hyper-Connections (mHC) extend a Transformer's residual stream into multiple parallel streams with learned cross-stream connections. Prior work trains all streams toward a shared objective. We instead study whether assigning distinct learning objectives to different streams can improve task performance and induce objective-specific specialization. Using complementary lexical (sparse) and semantic (dense) retrieval objectives as a test case, we find that objective-specialized mHC consistently outperforms a non-specialized mHC model across the full sparse--dense fusion range, for both two- and four-stream models and at two model scales. We then examine how specialization changes the model internally using probes of stream representations, residual mixing, objective-specific gradient flow, and read/write gates. The specialized and non-specialized models behave similarly through most of the network but diverge in the final layers: the specialized model develops increasingly objective-specific gradient flow, distinct read/write routing patterns, and reduced cross-stream mixing, and streams assigned to different objectives become increasingly dissimilar while those trained toward the same objective remain highly similar. Fixing the residual mixing to the identity leaves the specialization benefit intact, indicating that the benefit stems from objective-specific read/write routing rather than learned cross-stream mixing. These results show that assigning distinct objectives to mHC streams can improve multi-objective retrieval while inducing structured, depth-dependent specialization in the residual computation.
blocks.zh: 受手脚束缚 Hyper-Connections (mHC) 将变形器的剩余流扩展为多个平行流,并具有所学的跨流连接. 以前的工作使所有流程都朝着一个共同的目标发展。 相反,我们研究将不同的学习目标分配给不同的流是否能改善任务业绩和促成针对具体目标的专业化。 我们利用互补的词典(sparse)和语义(ense)检索目标作为试验案例,发现目标专用的mHC在全稀疏的聚变范围,双流和四流模式以及两个模式尺度上,始终比非专用的mHC模型表现得更好. 然后,我们审查专业化如何利用流表达、剩余混合、目标特定梯度流和读/写门探测器在内部改变模型。 专业和非专业模式在大多数网络中表现类似,但在最后几层中却有所不同:专业模式发展出日益针对目标的梯度流动,不同的读写路由模式,减少跨流混合,分配给不同目标的流水越来越不相同,而接受过相同目标培训的流水则高度相似。 将剩余混合物固定在身份上,使得专业化收益完好无损,表明该惠益来自针对特定目标的读写路由,而不是学到的跨流混合. 这些结果显示,为mHC流指定不同的目标可以改善多目标的检索,同时在剩余计算中诱导结构化的、依赖深度的专门化.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Manifold-constrained Hyper-Connections (mHC) Xie et al. (2025) replace a Transformer’s single residual stream with multiple parallel streams Zhu et al. (2024) , whose interactions are learned at each layer’s attention and feed-forward modules.
Existing applications of mHC jointly optimize all streams toward a shared objective Xie et al. (2025) ; Oldenburg et al. (2026) ; Mishra (2026) , leaving open a basic question: what happens when different streams are assigned different objectives?
blocks.zh:
受手脚束缚 Hyper-Connections (mHC) 谢等. (2025年)用多条平行流子Zhu等(2024年)来取而代之的变形器单相残流,其相互作用在每一层的注意力和向导模块中都有所学习.
mHC的现有应用共同优化了所有流向共同目标Xie等人(2025年);Oldenburg等人(2026年);Mishra (2026年),留下了一个基本问题:当不同的流被赋予不同的目标时会发生什么?

blocks.en:
Distinct objectives can benefit from shared representations and computation Caruana (1997) ; Liu et al. (2019) , while task-specific processing can be beneficial when objectives require different information Misra et al. (2016) ; Sun et al. (2019) .
This motivates objective-specialized mHC, in which different streams are assigned distinct learning objectives while retaining the ability to interact through learned connections.
blocks.zh:
不同的目标可以从共享表述和计算出Caruana(1997年);Liu等人(2019年)中受益,而当目标需要不同信息时,针对具体任务的处理可能是有益的(2016年);Sun等人(2019年)。
这激发了目标专用的mHC,其中不同的流被赋予不同的学习目标,同时保留通过所学联系进行互动的能力.

blocks.en: We investigate two questions. RQ1: Can mHC streams specialize toward distinct learning objectives while improving joint task performance? (Section 4 ) RQ2: How does this specialization emerge across depth, as reflected in inter-stream representations, gradient flow, and read, write, and residual-mixing gates? (Section 5 ).
blocks.zh: 我们调查两个问题。 RQ1: mHC流能否专门实现不同的学习目标,同时改善联合任务绩效? (第4节) RQ2:这种专业化是如何在跨深度出现,反映在流间表达、梯度流动、读取、写取和剩余混合门上? (第5节)

blocks.en:
As a concrete test case, we consider two complementary information-retrieval objectives: lexical and semantic matching Lin and Lin (2023) ; Lee et al. (2023) .
We train two- and four-stream mHC models, assigning each objective to a disjoint subset of streams, and evaluate at two model scales, ModernBERT-base and ModernBERT-large Warner et al. (2024) , to test whether the effect of specialization holds beyond a single model size.
Across 13 BEIR benchmarks Thakur et al. (2021) , the pattern is consistent at both scales: objective specialization improves average nDCG@10 from 0.4310 0.4310 to 0.4486 0.4486 with two streams and from 0.4410 0.4410 to 0.4529 0.4529 with four streams at the base scale, and from 0.4574 0.4574 to 0.4667 0.4667 and from 0.4573 0.4573 to 0.4748 0.4748 , respectively, at the larger scale.
In addition, we demonstrate that the specialized models outperform their non-specialized counterparts across the full sparse–dense fusion range at both scales.
blocks.zh:
作为具体的测试案例,我们考虑两个互补的信息检索目标:语法和语义匹配林和林(2023年);李等(2023年).
我们培养出双流和四流的mHC模型,将每个目标分配到一串分流的分流中,并在两个模型尺度,即ModernBERT-base和ModernBERT-group Warner等(2024年)进行评价,以测试专业化的效果是否超过单一模型大小.
13个贝鲁特区域基准 Thakur等人(2021年),两种尺度的格局都是一致的:客观专业化提高了平均nDCG@10,从0.4310 0.4310到0.4486 0.4486,有两条流;从0.4410 0.4410到0.4529 04529,有四条流为基数;从0.4574 04574到0.4667 0/467和从0.4573 04573到0.4748 04748,分别从较大尺度.
此外,我们表明,在两种规模上,专业模型在全稀有的密集聚变范围上都超过了非专业模型。

blocks.en:
Beyond retrieval performance, we analyze how objective specialization emerges within the mHC stack using complementary measurements of stream routing, gradient flow, and inter-stream representations.
These diagnostics reveal a consistent depth-dependent pattern.
Through most of the Transformer, specialized and non-specialized models exhibit similar residual mixing and read/write routing, while gradients from the two objectives remain broadly distributed across streams.
In the final layers, however, the specialized models exhibit a distinct pattern absent in the non-specialized models: gradient flow becomes increasingly concentrated on the streams assigned to each objective, read/write routing becomes asymmetric, with the MLP increasingly reading from the sparse-objective streams and writing toward the dense-objective streams, and residual mixing moves toward the identity.
Additionally, the representation analysis provides a clear contrast: in the non-specialized model, all streams remain highly similar throughout the network, whereas in the specialized model, streams assigned to different objectives become increasingly dissimilar in the final layers.
These effects persist when increasing from two to four streams, suggesting that mHC supports shared computation at early depths followed by objective-specific processing near the output.
Finally, fixing the residual mixing to the identity leaves the specialization benefit intact, indicating that the benefit stems from the objective-specific read/write routing rather than from learned cross-stream mixing.
blocks.zh:
除了检索性能之外,我们分析在mHC堆栈中如何利用对流径、梯度流和流间表现的补充测量来产生客观的专业化。
这些诊断揭示出一种一致的深度依赖模式.
通过大多数变形器,专用的和非专用的模型呈现出类似的剩余混合并读取/写出路由,而两个目标的梯度仍然广泛分布于各流.
然而,在最后几层,非专门化模型中缺乏一种独特的模式:梯度流越来越集中在分配给每个目标的溪流上,读取/写出路由变得不对称,而MLP则越来越多地从零星的目标溪流上读取并书写到密集的目标溪流上,而残余的混合则朝身份方向移动。
此外,代表性分析提供了一个明显的对比:在非专门模式中,所有流在整个网络中仍然高度相似,而在专门模式中,分配给不同目标的流在最后几层中越来越相异。
这些效应在从2个流增加到4个流时持续存在,表明mHC支持在早期深度共享计算,然后在产出附近进行特定目标处理.
最后,将剩余混合物固定在身份上,使得专门化效益完好无损,表明该效益来源于针对特定目标的读取/写取路由,而不是从所学的跨流混合.

blocks.en: Together, these results show how objective specialization in mHC emerges across depth, connecting retrieval gains to changes in stream representations, gradient flow, and routing. To our knowledge, we are the first to assign distinct learning objectives to different mHC streams and characterize the resulting specialization across the Transformer stack.
blocks.zh: 这些结果共同表明,mHC的客观专业化是如何跨越深度出现,将检索收益与溪流表达、梯度流动和路由的变化联系起来的。 据我们所知,我们首先为不同的mHC流指定了不同的学习目标,并描述由此形成在整个变形器堆栈的专业化.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Hyper-Connections
blocks.zh: 2.1 超连接

blocks.en:
Residual connections provide an identity path that allows representations to propagate across layers without transformation.
Hyper-Connections (HC) Zhu et al. (2024) generalize this paradigm by expanding the residual pathway into multiple parallel streams.
HC allows the multiple streams to interact through learned connectivity patterns, providing greater flexibility in how information propagates through depth.
Manifold-Constrained Hyper-Connections (mHC) Xie et al. (2025) constrain these learned connections to the Birkhoff polytope Sinkhorn and Knopp (1967) , ensuring that the residual mixing matrices remain doubly stochastic and thereby preserve the stability of the residual pathway while retaining learned cross-stream interactions.
Recent work has also begun to examine how the multiple residual streams introduced by HC and mHC are actually used after training Alimaskina et al. (2026) ; Zhao et al. (2026) .
Our work builds on this multi-stream formulation but changes how the streams are trained: rather than jointly optimizing all streams toward the same objective, we assign different objectives to different streams and study the resulting organization of information flow across depth.
blocks.zh:
残余接通提供了一种身份路径,使得表达方式能够在不转换的情况下跨层传播.
Hyper-Connections (HC) 朱等. (2024)通过将剩余路径扩展为多条平行流来概括这一范式.
HC允许多条流通过所学的连通模式进行互动,在信息如何通过深度传播方面提供更大的灵活性.
Manifold-Constructed Hyper-Connections (mHC) 谢等. (2025年)限制这些与伯克霍夫多管线(Birkhoff polytope Sinkhorn)和克诺普(Knopp)(1967年)的交流,确保了剩余混合基质保持双向分色,从而保持了剩余路径的稳定性,同时保留了所学习到的跨流相互作用.
最近的工作还开始研究HC和mHC引入的多条残流在训练Alimaskina等人(2026年)后的实际使用方式;Zhao等人(2026年).
我们的工作以这种多流的制定为基础,但改变了培训流程的方式:我们不是共同优化所有流程,而是为了实现同一目标,而是为不同的流程分配不同的目标,并研究由此产生的跨深度信息流动的组织。

blocks.en: 2.2 Multi-Task and Multi-Objective Learning
blocks.zh: 2.2 多任务和多目标学习

blocks.en:
Multi-task learning aims to share computation across tasks while reducing task interference Caruana (1997) ; Crawshaw (2020) . Prior work addresses this by learning task-specific representations or routing capacity, using approaches such as cross-stitch networks and mixture-of-experts Misra et al. (2016) ; Ma et al. (2018) ; Gupta et al. (2022) .
Our setting instead attaches distinct objectives directly to different mHC streams within the residual computation, allowing the streams to remain coupled while developing objective-specific behavior.
blocks.zh:
多任务学习旨在分享跨任务的计算,同时减少任务干扰 Caruana (1997); Crawshaw (2020). 先前的工作通过学习具体任务表述或路由能力来解决这一问题,采用的方法包括跨层网络和混合专家Misra等(2016年);Ma等(2018年);Gupta等(2022年)。
相反,我们的设定将不同的目标直接附在剩余计算中的不同mHC流上,使得流在发展特定目标行为的同时能够保持相接.

blocks.en: 2.3 Multi-Representation Retrieval
blocks.zh: 2.3 多代表检索

blocks.en:
Modern information retrieval increasingly combines representations that capture different notions of relevance.
Sparse retrieval emphasizes lexical matching and exact or token-level correspondence, whereas dense retrieval captures semantic similarity through continuous representations Formal et al. (2021) ; Lin and Lin (2023) .
These signals are complementary: combining lexical and semantic matching can improve retrieval effectiveness and robustness over either representation alone Lin and Lin (2023) ; Lee et al. (2023) .
blocks.zh:
现代信息检索越来越多地将反映不同相关性概念的表述结合起来。
Sparse reference强调语法匹配和准确或符号级的函证,而密集的取回则通过连续的表示形式等(2021)来捕捉语义相似性;Lin和Lin (2023).
这些信号是互补的:结合词汇和语义匹配,可以提高检索的有效性和稳健性,而不是仅代表Lin和Lin(2023);Lee等(2023)。

blocks.en:
Recent retrieval models demonstrate the value of combining complementary relevance signals within a single model.
BGE-M3 Chen et al. (2024) , for example, supports dense, sparse, and multi-vector retrieval within a unified encoder, showing that multiple retrieval representations can be supported and efficiently combined.
We instead ask whether distinct learning objectives can be assigned directly to different internal mHC streams, and how such specialization emerges across the Transformer stack.
We use sparse and dense retrieval as complementary objectives to study this question.
blocks.zh:
最近的检索模型表明,在一个单一模型中将互补的相关信号结合起来是有价值的。
BGE-M3 Chen等 (2024) 例如,在统一的编码器内支持密集,稀有,多向量的检索,表明可以支持并高效地结合多种检索表达.
相反,我们询问是否可以将不同的学习目标直接分配给不同的mHC内部流,以及这种专业化如何在变形器堆栈中出现。
我们利用稀疏而密集的检索作为研究这一问题的补充目标。

blocks.en: 2.4 Retrofitting Pretrained Models with mHC
blocks.zh: 2.4 与mHC相适应的预培训模型

blocks.en:
Closely related to our setup is the use of mHC as a retrofit onto an already-pretrained model.
Oldenburg et al. ( Oldenburg et al., 2026 ) wrap a pretrained model’s residual stream with mHC for parameter-efficient fine-tuning.
We likewise retrofit mHC onto a pretrained encoder, but differ in two respects: we fine-tune all parameters (both the backbone and the mHC routing), and we assign distinct objectives to different streams rather than optimizing all streams toward a common objective.
blocks.zh:
与我们的设置密切相关的是 使用mHC作为改装 在一个已经训练有素的模型。
奥尔登堡等. (Oldenburg等,2026年)用mHC来包裹一个被预先训练过的模型的残余流来进行参数高效的微调.
我们同样将mHC改装成一个经过预先训练的编码器,但是在两个方面有所不同:我们微调所有参数(主干线和mHC的路由线),我们为不同的溪流指定不同的目标,而不是优化所有溪流,以实现一个共同目标。

blocks.en: 3.2 Encoder for Information Retrieval
blocks.zh: 3.2 信息检索编码器

blocks.en:
We start from the publicly available, pretrained ModernBERT encoder ( Warner et al., 2024 ) , using both the base ( L = 22 L=22 layers, hidden size d = 768 d=768 ) 1 1 1 https://huggingface.co/answerdotai/ModernBERT-base and large ( L = 28 L=28 layers, d = 1024 d=1024 ) 2 2 2 https://huggingface.co/answerdotai/ModernBERT-large variants, and fine-tune each for retrieval.
We retrofit mHC onto the pretrained encoder by wrapping every self-attention and MLP sublayer in an mHC block (Section 3.1 ) with n ∈ { 2 , 4 } n\in\{2,4\} streams.
The retrofit is function-preserving at initialization: for every layer l l , the resulting stream x l + 1 ( s ) x_{l+1}^{(s)} is identical across all streams s ∈ { 0 , … , n − 1 } s\in\{0,\dots,n-1\} and equal to the hidden state the pretrained ModernBERT model would produce at that layer (Appendix A ). Fine-tuning therefore starts from the pretrained ModernBERT function, with any subsequent stream specialization learned during retrieval training.

Figure 1: Schematic comparison of the three encoder configurations studied in this work. In all three, streams propagate through the full encoder stack and the retrieval heads read only the final-layer ( l = L l=L ) stream representations. (left) Single-stream : the standard ModernBERT encoder, with a single residual stream read by both the sparse and dense retrieval heads. (middle) Non-specialized mHC : the residual stream is expanded into n n parallel streams with learned cross-stream routing. Both retrieval heads operate on the mean-pooled representation obtained from all n n streams, so the sparse and dense objectives jointly optimize the same stream representation. (right) Objective-specialized mHC : the sparse and dense heads instead read disjoint sets of final-layer streams, so each objective selectively trains its assigned stream(s).

blocks.en:
To address RQ1, we ask whether mHC residual streams can specialize to distinct learning objectives while improving multi-objective retrieval.
We compare objective-specialized mHC ( mHC+spec ) against three baselines: (1) dedicated single-objective models , which provide single-task reference points; (2) a standard non-mHC joint model ( Sparse+Dense ), which combines the two objectives within a conventional single residual stream; and (3) a non-specialized mHC model ( mHC no-spec ), in which both retrieval heads read the pooled mHC streams.
The third comparison is the key ablation: mHC no-spec and mHC+spec use the same architecture, training data, and optimization budget, differing only in whether the objectives are assigned to distinct streams. We evaluate both n = 2 n=2 and n = 4 n=4 streams.
We evaluate our system on 13 BEIR datasets Thakur et al. (2021) and report results averaged over two training seeds.

blocks.en: The results show three findings. First, at the base scale, four-stream mHC models outperform the conventional Sparse+Dense model, while the two-stream models are comparable. This comparison is secondary, since mHC introduces additional stream-specific parameters and routing capacity 6 6 6 mHC introduces a modest parameter overhead relative to the corresponding single-stream model: approximately 0.41 % 0.41\% for n = 2 n=2 and 2.25 % 2.25\% for n = 4 n=4 . . Second, and more importantly, mHC+spec consistently outperforms mHC no-spec at every fusion weight for both n = 2 n=2 and n = 4 n=4 ; Figure 2 shows that this also holds at a larger model scale (ModernBERT-large). At α = 0.9 \alpha=0.9 and the base scale, specialization improves average nDCG@10 from 0.4310 0.4310 to 0.4486 0.4486 with two streams and from 0.4410 0.4410 to 0.4529 0.4529 with four streams (ModernBERT-large: 0.4574 → 0.4667 0.4574\to 0.4667 and 0.4573 → 0.4748 0.4573\to 0.4748 , respectively). Thus, the improvement is not explained simply by the additional capacity of mHC, but by how that capacity is organized across objectives. Third, the specialization benefit persists across the full sparse–dense fusion range rather than depending on a particular operating point, at both model scales.

Since the specialized and non-specialized models have the same architecture and capacity, their performance difference raises a more specific question: how does assigning different objectives to the streams change the internal computation? We therefore ask whether, where, and how the two models diverge internally ( RQ2 ).
The models share the same architecture, training data, and optimization budget and differ only in whether or not the retrieval heads read disjoint stream groups, allowing us to attribute systematic internal differences to objective specialization.

这些模型共享相同的架构,培训数据和优化预算,仅在检索头是否读取脱节流组上存在差异,使我们能够将系统性的内部差异归因于客观的专业化.

We first ask whether objective specialization produces different stream representations.
At each layer, we compute the cosine similarity between token-averaged stream states.
The non-specialized models remain highly similar across streams, whereas the specialized models increasingly separate streams assigned to different objectives in the final layers.
With two streams, cosine similarity falls to ≈ 0.3 \approx 0.3 at layer 21; with four streams, streams assigned to the same objective remain nearly identical ( cos ≈ 0.99 \cos\!\approx\!0.99 ), while cross-objective pairs diverge ( cos ≈ 0.26 \cos\!\approx\!0.26 ) (Figure 3 ).
Thus, specialization organizes the streams into objective-specific groups rather than simply replicating the same representation across all streams. 7 7 7 We use cosine similarity as the primary measure of inter-stream similarity. We also evaluated linear CKA, but it remained close to 1 1 across the network and did not show the depth-dependent separation observed with cosine similarity.

blocks.en:
Taken together, the four probes reveal a consistent depth-dependent pattern. The specialized and non-specialized models remain similar through most of the network, but diverge in the final layers: streams assigned to different objectives become more distinct, objective-specific gradients concentrate on their assigned streams, the gates develop a directional read/write pattern (preferentially reading from sparse-assigned streams and writing to dense-assigned streams), and residual mixing decreases.
The results therefore connect the downstream benefit of objective specialization to a concrete change in the internal computation of mHC rather than to a difference in capacity alone.

Specialization drives the residual-mixing matrix toward the identity in the final layers.
This suggests a hypothesis: the specialization benefit stems from the objective-specific read/write routing rather than from learned cross-stream mixing.
To test it, we fix A ℓ = I A_{\ell}=I at every layer, so that each stream is carried forward unmixed and streams interact only through the read and write gates, and retrain both the specialized and non-specialized models with n = 4 n=4 (Table 2 ).
Fixing the mixing to the identity changes average nDCG@10 by less than the variation across seeds, and this holds with or without specialization: mHC no-spec scores 0.4410 0.4410 with learned and 0.4415 0.4415 with identity mixing, and mHC+spec scores 0.4529 0.4529 and 0.4546 0.4546 , respectively.
Crucially, the specialization gain is preserved ( + 0.0119 +0.0119 with learned mixing, + 0.0131 +0.0131 with identity mixing), well beyond the seed-to-seed standard deviation.
These results support the hypothesis: learned cross-stream mixing is not required for the specialization benefit, which instead stems from the objective-specific read/write routing.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
We studied whether mHC residual streams can be assigned distinct learning objectives, using sparse and dense retrieval as a testbed.
Specialization consistently improves retrieval over non-specialized mHC models of identical capacity, training data, and optimization budget, across the full sparse–dense fusion range and for both n = 2 n{=}2 and n = 4 n{=}4 streams, and this holds at both ModernBERT-base and ModernBERT-large scales.
The specialized models also improve over the conventional single-stream joint retriever, with the n = 4 n{=}4 model achieving the best BEIR score at both scales.
blocks.zh:
我们研究了mHC残余流是否可以被赋予不同的学习目标,使用稀疏而密集的检索作为试验床.
专业在全稀有的聚变范围内,以及n=2n{=}2和n=4n{=}4的流流中,不断改进相同容量、培训数据和优化预算的非专业mHC模型的检索,这在ModernBERT基地和ModernBERT大尺度上都有。
相较于传统的单流联合回取器,专业模式也有所改进,n = 4 n{=}4模式在两种尺度上都实现了最佳BEIR分.

blocks.en:
Our analyses further show that specialization emerges primarily in the final layers.
There, stream representations diverge, objective-specific gradients concentrate on assigned streams, the MLP gates develop a read-from-sparse / write-to-dense pattern, and residual mixing moves toward the identity.
At n = 4 n{=}4 , streams assigned to the same objective remain similar, forming two coherent objective groups.
Fixing the residual mixing to the identity leaves the specialization benefit intact, indicating that it stems from the objective-specific read/write routing rather than from learned cross-stream mixing.
Together, these results show that assigning distinct objectives to mHC streams can both improve downstream performance and induce structured, depth-localized specialization within the streams.

在那里,溪流的表达方式有差异,目标特定的梯度集中于所分配的溪流上,MLP门发展出从sparse / 写到dense的读取模式,而残余的混合向身份移动.

这些结果表明,为mHC流指定不同的目标既能改善下游的性能,又能促进溪流内部结构化、深度化的专门化。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: We study a single pair of objectives—lexical (sparse) and semantic (dense) retrieval—chosen because they are related but distinct. We do not systematically vary the degree of objective divergence, and therefore cannot determine how specialization changes as objectives become more similar, complementary, or conflicting.
blocks.zh: 我们研究的是一对单一的目标—— 语义(sparse)和语义(dense)检索—— 因为它们是相互联系的,但是是不同的。 我们没有系统地改变客观分歧的程度,因此无法确定随着目标更加相似、互补或相互冲突,专业化如何发生变化。

blocks.en: Our experiments cover only two scales (ModernBERT-base and ModernBERT-base) with n ∈ { 2 , 4 } n\in\{2,4\} streams, and encoder-based retrieval. We therefore do not establish whether the observed performance gains or late-layer specialization patterns extend to other model scales, other numbers of streams or objectives, or decoder-based and generative tasks.

blocks.en:
In our specialized mHC models, we allocated an equal number of streams to the sparse and dense objectives.
We leave the effect of asymmetric stream allocation on downstream performance to future work.

Whereas the MLP shifts its read gate toward the sparse stream and its write gate toward the dense stream, attention leaves its read gate essentially unchanged ( Δ ​ s ​ ( p ℓ ) ≈ 0 \Delta s(p_{\ell})\approx 0 ) and moves only its write gate—strongly—toward the dense-assigned stream(s) ( Δ ​ s ​ ( q L ) ≈ − 0.44 \Delta s(q_{L})\approx-0.44 at n = 2 n{=}2 and − 0.45 -0.45 at n = 4 n{=}4 ).
